notes.title: Empire of Lust Demo – Update & Fixes
notes.content: [h3]Hey there! [/h3][h3]Thanks for playing the Empire of Lust Demo and sending us your feedback! We’ve released a small update that addresses several issues and improves overall stability.[/h3][h3]🛠️ [b]Here’s what we’ve improved in last update:[/b][/h3][h3]🔹Reputation display update issue[/h3][h3]🔹Reputation exploit on mini-game exit[/h3][h3]🔹Localiztion issues[/h3][h3]🔹Girl icon state not updating on location[/h3][h3]🔹Chariot mini-game exploit[/h3][h3]🔹Minor visual polish[/h3][h3]🔹Log window UI improvements[/h3][h3]🔹Gallery now locked on start[/h3][h3]🔹Sex game balance adjustments[/h3][p][/p][h3]And don't forget this is still the demo — so keep sending in your feedback and thoughts. The more you share, the hotter the full version gets! 😉🔥[/h3]
